name: DlightRAG · a run was lost to an outage or an abandoned lease
message: a run was lost to a dependency that stayed out or to a lease that was reclaimed one time too many; the bucket that breached saw {{value}}. the kind is the span's dlightrag.error.kind where its executor classified it and its status description otherwise, so a loss the durable store settled is grouped the same way, and the run's own row in postgres carries it durably.

chartConfig.name: lost run-answer spans
chartConfig.sqlTemplate:
SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS ts,
  multiIf(SpanAttributes['dlightrag.error.kind'] IN ('run_abandoned', 'dependency_unavailable'),
          SpanAttributes['dlightrag.error.kind'],
          StatusMessage ILIKE '%run_abandoned%' OR StatusMessage ILIKE '%abandoned%', 'run_abandoned',
          'dependency_unavailable') AS error_kind,
  count() AS lost_runs
FROM otel_traces
WHERE startsWith(ServiceName, 'dlightrag')
  AND SpanName = 'run-answer'
  AND StatusCode = 'Error'
  AND (SpanAttributes['dlightrag.error.kind'] IN ('run_abandoned', 'dependency_unavailable')
       OR StatusMessage ILIKE '%run_abandoned%' OR StatusMessage ILIKE '%abandoned%'
       OR StatusMessage ILIKE '%dependency_unavailable%' OR StatusMessage ILIKE '%unavailable%')
  AND $__timeFilter_ms(Timestamp)
GROUP BY ts, error_kind
ORDER BY ts
LIMIT 1000
